title: So bright
prompt:
So-bright cosmic-light interlude. From this exact starting composition, gently pan toward the bright star in the upper-right; let the unchanged laboratory ark gradually slip toward and partly beyond the lower-left edge. The visual attention passes from the hull to the luminous star and textured violet/cyan dust. Warm illustrated star bloom and subtle long luminous streaks evolve slowly, never strobing or becoming a blown-out white screen. Smooth functional motion, not a repeated ship zoom. Keep the same coherent ark while visible. No new spacecraft, planets or geometry changes. One uninterrupted six-second exterior shot. Motion established at the start and continuous throughout. Preserve exact illustrated painterly graphic-novel rendering and source geometry. No cuts, internal dissolves, readable text, captions, generated audio or new objects.

PROMPT LOCK: Cinematic painterly graphic-novel space adventure matching the approved laboratory-ark stills. The headquarters ark is the same massive elongated graphite submarine-like vessel with oval cyan-lit culture galleries, amber longitudinal lights, asymmetric branching service spars and restrained cyan aft drive. Preserve complete hull geometry and lighting design across exterior views. Cosmic space is deep indigo-black with richly painted cyan/violet nebulae and warm illustrated star bloom. Exterior views only: do not introduce human figures or interior views. No readable text, captions, logos, watermark, panel divisions, camera shake or zoom blur.
reviewNotes: Starlight blooms gently across the hull and dust; measured lateral drift. Hold through the 7-frame gap.
